text: A monoclonal antibody (MAb) specific to apramycin (AP) was produced to develop an indirect competitive ELISA (idcELISA) and a rapid testing strip for AP residues in foods. The MAb showed negligible cross-reactivity with other aminoglycosides. Optimized in 0.01 M PBS, the MAb gave an IC50 of 0.41 ng/ml and a limit of detection (LOD) of 0.15 ng/ml, with ELISA results within 90 min. Mean recoveries from spiked foods were 79.02–105.49%, with coefficients of variation of 2.21–11.4%. Strip results were obtained within 5 min, with visual LODs of 2.5–5 µg/kg (ng/ml) across all foods tested. The strip test offers a fast, convenient method for detecting AP residues in foods.
